title: Change your default currency
description: Quick XRP Mobile tutorial: change the app's default currency from Settings. The selector shows each currency's code, name and symbol, and search matches names too, so switching from euros to Japanese Yen takes seconds.
lede: Prefer prices in yen, euros or dollars? Let's make XRP Mobile speak your currency.

steps.caption: Open XRP Mobile
steps.body: Open XRP Mobile. We start from a fresh wallet, and setup takes less than a minute.

steps.caption: Quick setup
steps.body: Create the wallet, name it, back up the recovery phrase and set your PIN.

steps.caption: Open your wallet
steps.body: Open your wallet, skip the notifications prompt, and you're on the home screen.

steps.caption: Go to Settings
steps.body: Tap the gear to open Settings.

steps.caption: Tap Default currency
steps.body: Under General, tap Default currency. Every entry shows its code, its name and its symbol, so you always know what you're picking.

steps.caption: Search by name
steps.body: Search works by name too. Type yen and Japanese Yen pops right up.

steps.caption: Done, prices in yen
steps.body: Tap it, and done. The whole app now shows prices in Japanese Yen. You can change it back anytime.
